newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Mayr-Melnhof in JV with Turkey's Korimpeks.
newsitem.headline: Mayr-Melnhof in JV with Turkey's Korimpeks.

text.p: Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG, Europe's leading manufacturer of cartonboard, said on Tuesday it had signed a contract for a joint venture with Turkey's Korimpeks.
Both companies will hold 50 percent in the enterprise, MMK said in a statement. The cooperation is expected to raise cartonboard sales to 50,000 tonnes within the next few years.

"Turkey is at present one of the most dynamic growth markets for cartonboard from wastepaper. In the last three years Mayr-Melnhof Karton managed to raise sales from 3,200 to around 20,000 tonnes a year," MMK said.
